zh.excerpt: 从 81 章生活漫画，到看世界、读一章、午间小憩：做出来的产品开始走进日常，也慢慢连成了一种生活方式。

en.label: Field Notes
en.title: I Built a Few Products with AI—and Slowly Pieced Together the Life I Want
en.excerpt: From 81 everyday-life comics to a daily rhythm of seeing the world, reading a chapter, and resting at noon: the products I made are becoming a way of living.

zh.label: 片刻随记
zh.title: 自己很喜欢，别人会买单吗？做产品最难跨过的这一步
zh.excerpt: 自己的需要可以让产品开始；真正走向市场，还要找到具体的问题、讲清价值，并完成一次真实交易。

en.label: Field Notes
en.title: You Love It. Will Anyone Pay for It? The Hardest Step in Building a Product
en.excerpt: Your own need can start a product. Reaching a market takes a concrete problem, clear value, a small real transaction, and a business you can keep running.

zh.label: 片刻随记
zh.title: 我的 App 开始有人付费了。钱不多，但我很开心

en.label: Field Notes
en.title: People Are Paying for My App. Not Much Money, but I’m Happy.
en.excerpt: Two transactions and CNY 11.41 in estimated revenue. A small beginning worth celebrating—and a reason to keep improving something I use myself.

zh.label: 片刻随记
zh.title: OpenAI Dots来了：AI越来越能干，我能少操点心了吗？
zh.excerpt: 真正让人轻松的，不是 AI 多做几件事，而是它能持续推进、懂得边界，让一件反复挂念的工作真正被交出去。

en.label: FIELD NOTES
en.title: OpenAI Dots Is Here: As AI Gets More Capable, Can I Worry Less?
en.excerpt: What creates relief is not simply AI doing more, but an agent that can carry work forward, respect boundaries, and truly take one recurring responsibility off your mind.

zh.label: 片刻随记

zh.excerpt: AI 真正进入现实世界，靠的不只是更聪明的模型，而是电话、邮箱、钱包、电脑，以及清楚的授权和责任边界。

en.label: FIELD NOTES
en.title: When an Agent Has a Phone Number and a Wallet, It Is No Longer Just a Chat Box: Manus Cue Enters the Physical World
en.excerpt: For AI to enter the physical world, it needs more than a smarter model: a phone, email, wallet, computer, and clear boundaries for permission and responsibility.

zh.label: 片刻随记
zh.title: 当AI能写代码、做设计、搞运营，普通互联网人还剩下什么？
zh.excerpt: AI 正在抹平执行力的差距，却在放大判断力的差距。真正值钱的，是发现问题、做出取舍、理解人，并愿意为结果负责。

en.label: FIELD NOTES
en.title: When AI Can Code, Design, and Run Operations, What Is Left for Ordinary Internet Professionals?
en.excerpt: AI is narrowing the gap in execution while widening the gap in judgment. Value now lies in finding problems, making choices, understanding people, and owning outcomes.

en.label: FIELD NOTES
en.title: AI Employees Have Started Work: A One-Person Company Can Finally Have a Digital Team
en.excerpt: A one-person company expands through the range of work one person can direct. AI executes; the creator keeps direction, taste, empathy, and responsibility.

en.label: FIELD NOTES
en.title: The Best Ad May No Longer Be an Image, but a Salesperson You Can Talk To
en.excerpt: When an ad can understand space, budget, preferences, and doubts, the opportunity is to turn product knowledge into an honest conversation.

en.label: FIELD NOTES
en.title: The New Siri Is Here: AI Will Not Kill Apps, but It Will Eliminate One Kind of App
en.excerpt: People may stop opening your app while continuing to use its value. Siri is turning apps from destinations into capabilities AI can understand and call.
